items.summary: Staff: Grok Bot has no codebase plugin and does not index your repo; coding work is handed to a Cursor Cloud Agent on a GitHub-connected account (Dashboard → Integrations), with an optional GitHub PAT connector for read-only, auto-created repos from scratch, and no Origin access yet.

items.title: Phantom in Grok Bot is a Mess
items.summary: Staff: the Phantom plugin runs on @phantom/mcp-server and each new auth creates a separate dedicated agent wallet, not your personal Phantom wallet, so reconnects show a new address while funded funds stay on the old agent wallet (recover via chat history or Phantom Support).

items.title: Grokbot custom connectors
items.summary: Staff: there is no settings form for custom connectors; tell the Bot in chat to add an MCP server (public HTTPS streamable HTTP/SSE), confirm the details, and new tools appear from the next message — localhost-only MCP on your PC is unreachable from the cloud computer.

items.title: Grok Bot: Drive MCP should write Google Docs body and Sheet cells, not only file metadata
items.summary: Staff: in-place Google Doc/Sheet editing lives in the dedicated Docs and Sheets connectors (edit content against the existing file ID), while Drive is file-level only; add both from the connector marketplace with the same Google account.

items.title: Blank screen after opening Grok Bot
items.summary: Staff: a blank/white screen usually means the desktop app cannot reach the cloud computer; Cloudflare WARP can intercept that traffic even on a hotspot — turn WARP off or use split tunneling/excluded routes, and prefer builds after 0.28.0 that show an error+retry instead of a blank screen.

items.title: Cloud Agents created in Grok Bot not displayed in Cursor
items.summary: Staff: Cloud Agents launched from Grok Bot keep running under your account but stay hidden on cursor.com/agents and the desktop sidebar until you enable filter Source > Grok Bot (once per client: web and desktop).

items.title: Can't reach your computer from last 72 hours
items.summary: Staff: when the cloud computer is healthy but the app still says Can’t reach, set both IPv4 and IPv6 DNS to 1.1.1.1/8.8.8.8 (JioFiber routers often keep IPv6 DNS) or confirm via a phone hotspot on another carrier.

items.title: Grok Bot 0.30.0 stuck on "Setting up your Grok Bot" on macOS
items.summary: Staff: endless Setting up your Grok Bot on a free Cursor plan means no hosted machine is provisioned — needs Pro/Pro+/Ultra/Teams or linked SuperGrok/Plus/Heavy; the spinner instead of an access message is a known UX bug.

items.title: Grok Bot Zoom plugin OAuth hardcodes http://localhost:8787/callback — Zoom rejects hostname localhost (error 4700)
items.summary: Staff: the catalog Zoom plugin OAuth hardcodes http://localhost:8787/callback, which Zoom rejects (error 4700); no user workaround until the redirect moves off localhost (e.g. 127.0.0.1).

items.title: Unable to reconnect to my Grok Bot's computer after attempted update
items.summary: Staff: bots/files/logins live on the remote computer; Can’t Reach plus failed Recover/Reset often means a lost app login session — fully quit, sign out/in (or reinstall and sign in), since Recover/Reset need a working session.

items.title: Grok Bot Computer Stuck in Partial State — Reset Failed, Existing Cloud Computer Unreachable
items.summary: Staff: hold off on Reset/Recover after a scary partial-state dialog — data is remote and failed resets often failed on the app side; re-login, verify via mobile on cellular, and try public DNS / disable VPN before resetting.

items.title: Grok Bot couldn't finish setup
items.summary: Staff: Can’t reach your computer on Linux Grok Bot 0.18.0 is not your network — Grok Bot is not officially available on Linux yet and that old build is rejected; supported platforms are macOS, Windows, and iOS.

items.title: Grok Bot 0.30.0 (Windows) — setup fails with Can't reach your computer, all network checks pass
items.summary: Staff: the app reaches a per-computer subdomain under cursorvm.com, not the apex — if nslookup test123.us8.cursorvm.com is Query refused while the apex works, change DNS on both IPv4 and IPv6 (router RA can keep the ISP resolver even after 1.1.1.1).

items.title: Cloud computer wipes packages after rebuild
items.summary: Staff: Update Computer keeps files and logins but rebuilds the OS image, so apt/apps/daemons are gone; the box also sleeps when idle (background processes die) and can auto-update during idle — keep a package list in a file and ask the Bot to reinstall after an update.

items.title: /review-bugbot is missing on cloud agents launched from Grok Bot
items.summary: Staff: /review and /review-bugbot do not attach to cloud agents created by Grok Bot (decided at create time); start a new agent from cursor.com/agents on the same PR branch and include /review-bugbot there.

items.title: Grok Bot Bug Report (empty roster / black screen after reconnect)
items.summary: Staff: empty bot list and black/white loading after reconnect usually means the Agent Computer was slow waking from sleep—nothing deleted; do not Reset; fully quit and relaunch once the box is awake.

items.title: Grokbot and GitHub (Connected but Authorization header badly formatted)
items.summary: Staff: GitHub connector shows Connected but fails with “Authorization header is badly formatted”—tracked bug; workaround is press-and-hold the account → Remove, then reconnect and sign in again.

items.title: Authorization death by 1000 clicks
items.summary: Staff: “Always allow” for local-computer actions lives only in the desktop app on that machine; iOS can only one-time-approve, and those approvals clear on every new message—set Always Allow under desktop Settings → Execution on Local Computer.

items.title: Wrangler/box auth reminder stays stuck after auth already succeeded via another path
items.summary: Staff: the “help on its computer” / Waiting-for-you reminder only clears when you answer that card (“I’m done, continue” or Skip) or send any chat message—it does not auto-dismiss if the Bot finished login another way.

items.title: Fastmail Filters & Rules Save is a silent no-op (Chrome on the box)
items.summary: Staff: Fastmail Settings → Filters & Rules Save on the box Chrome fires zero network requests; workaround is manage filters/Sieve via Fastmail’s API (JMAP) with a token—the mail helper already uses that path successfully.

items.title: VPN, SSO, Passkey, and YubiKey Within Grokbot
items.summary: Staff: Grok Bot’s cloud computer cannot join a corporate VPN today (don’t install a VPN client on it — that can knock the box offline); Atlassian Cloud / public SSO works via browser takeover (Okta etc.), YubiKey works on macOS/Windows under Settings → Security Key, and internal VPN-only sites need Execution on Local Computer on your VPN’d machine.

items.title: Unable to connect
items.summary: Staff: chats and agents live on the hosted Grok Bot computer — during an outage recovery that computer can be temporarily replaced with a blank one (roster looks empty); Cursor can restore it from saved data, then quit and reopen the app to see agents/history again.

items.title: GrokBot Linux Execution on Local Computer not working
items.summary: Staff: empty ListMachines / local execution failing on Grok Bot 0.30.0 Linux is a known bug with a fix already merged for the next desktop update; interim workaround is an unlocked system keyring (gnome-keyring or KWallet), fully quit leftover Grok Bot processes, then relaunch.

items.title: New report, Windows, leftover daemon on 0.30.0
items.summary: Staff: 0.30.0 fixed one macOS daemon exit/no-respawn path, but Windows leftover local-exec-daemon is a different known failure; when the machine is unreachable, Quit from the tray, end remaining “Grok Bot” and local-exec-daemon processes in Task Manager, relaunch, and wait about a minute to re-register.

items.title: Grok bot failed to respond
items.summary: Staff (kevinn): “Bot failed to respond” on every bot—including fresh copies—means the shared cloud computer is stuck, not something you can fix by restarting or recreating bots; after staff recovery, fully quit (Cmd+Q / force-close iOS), update every install, keep one open, and test in a new chat.

items.title: Grok Bot 0.30.0 Stuck on Black Loading Screen During Initial Setup on Mac
items.summary: Staff (Colin): Team admin role alone does not provision a Grok Bot computer — Grok Bot is included with a paid team seat (Standard or Premium), not the admin role. If the signed-in account has no seat, the app sits on the black loading screen with no computer to reset. Fix: assign yourself a seat in Cursor dashboard Members, fully quit and reopen Grok Bot; or sign in with a seated team account.

items.title: Grok Bot Windows — fresh profile setup fails with “Can’t reach your computer” after backend fix
items.summary: Staff (deanrie): Grok Bot ignores the Windows system proxy / local HTTP proxy and connects direct to the Agent Computer — so DNS/TCP/CONNECT checks through a proxy can pass while the app fails. Use VPN/proxy TUN (Enhanced/Global/virtual adapter) mode, then verify with curl.exe --noproxy "*" -I https://test123.<region>.cursorvm.com (expect 404 awselb/2.0). User confirmed TUN fixed setup. Region may

items.title: Grok Bot 0.30.0 stuck on black loading screen on Windows 11
items.summary: Staff (Colin): Healthy cloud computer + black spinner on both LAN and hotspot can be Zscaler Client Connector still tunneling (including on hotspot). Quit Grok Bot, pause/disable Zscaler, relaunch; ask IT to allowlist/exclude SSL inspection for *.cursorvm.com and **.cursorvm.com (both levels).

items.title: Grok Bot 0.30.0 — Agent Computer unreachable after Update, Recover, and Reset all failed
items.summary: Staff (kevinn): An “Aw, Snap!” Chrome page on the Bot screen after idle wake is the Bot’s browser crashing inside a healthy computer — reload the tab or ask the Bot to reload, fully quit/reopen Grok Bot if needed, and do not run Update/Recover/Reset; idle machines take a moment to wake and a first message can miss, so resend is safe.

items.title: Grok Bot Mac “unavailable” after password reset (expired session)
items.summary: Staff (deanrie): After a password reset, Grok Bot on Mac can keep an expired session and show “isn’t available on this account yet” even though SuperGrok/Cursor access and your cloud computer/Bots are fine — Log out from the bottom of that screen, fully Quit (Cmd+Q), reopen and Sign in with the new password; Check Access→download is a misleading expired-session UI, not a missing entitlement.

items.title: Homepage “Approval needed” stuck after card timeout
items.summary: Staff (Colin): A homepage “Approval needed” tile with nothing pending usually means an approval card timed out (~10 minutes unanswered); open the agent and send a short message or restart the app to clear a stuck badge — the tile is supposed to clear when the card expires.

items.title: File contents and grokbot — viewer Copy vs Download
items.summary: Staff (Colin): The in-app file viewer only offers Download today; for .md/.txt you can click-drag to select and Cmd/Ctrl+C, while .docx/.pdf won’t highlight — ask the Bot to paste the full text into chat and use the message Copy action as a workaround.

items.title: Grok Bot Canva connector failing — Invalid redirect URI on iOS
items.summary: Staff (deanrie): Canva “Invalid redirect URI” on Grok Bot iOS 1.4.0 is a known app-link vs web-redirect mismatch (not your Canva settings) — connect Canva from desktop Grok Bot on the same account and the connector syncs to iPhone.

items.title: Local computer looks connected but CopyFromBox/Shell flaps after large transfer timeout
items.summary: Staff (deanrie): A large CopyFromBox (or timed-out Shell) can drop the local machine from the agent list for ~1 minute while Settings still says connected — split big copies, wait a minute before retrying, and if stuck Cmd+Q then pkill -f local-exec-daemon and reopen.

items.title: Grok Bot Windows — Can't reach computer on Free plan / after SuperGrok link
items.summary: Staff (deanrie): “Can't reach computer” can mean the signed-in Cursor account is Free with no Grok Bot entitlement (not DNS)—link SuperGrok on the same Cursor account via cursor.com, then fully sign out/in (or Quit from the Windows tray) so the desktop app refreshes access.

items.title: Grokbot failing to connect to cloud agent — Privacy Mode (Legacy) false positive
items.summary: Staff (deanrie): Launching a Cloud Agent from Grok Bot can falsely hit the “Privacy Mode (Legacy)” check after a recent release even when your account uses current Privacy Mode—Cursor Desktop launch still works; sign-out/reset won’t help; staff are tracking a server-side fix.

items.title: Grok Bot 0.39.0 first setup: Reconnecting forever until Privacy Mode is saved
items.summary: Staff (deanrie): First-setup “Reconnecting to your computer” can mean the account never saved an explicit Privacy Mode choice (data notice alone is not enough)—set Privacy Mode in cursor.com/dashboard → Settings → Privacy, fully Quit (Cmd+Q), reopen; Retry/Recover/Reset will not fix a missing privacy choice.

items.title: Status beat leaks between bots — one Bot memory across 1:1 and groups
items.summary: Staff (Colin): Status “leaks” across chats are expected—each Bot has one conversation and one memory spanning its 1:1 and every group it joins; group turns are room-tagged but memories belong to the Bot, so keep Project X and Y on separate Bots (or file notes under a project folder, which is less reliable than separate Bots).

items.title: Shopify browser blocked — use Admin API / custom MCP, not agent Chrome
items.summary: Staff (Colin): Shopify’s anti-bot check blocks the agent computer’s browser—skip login pages and use a store custom app Admin API token via Settings → Plugins custom MCP (community Shopify Admin MCP) until a first-party Shopify connector ships.

items.title: Unreachable after heavy media — 16 GB RAM exhaustion
items.summary: Staff (Colin): “Unreachable” during heavier media work often means the cloud machine hit its ~16 GB RAM ceiling within minutes—Recover keeps Bots/files/logins intact; until the machine rides it out, keep jobs under that memory budget.

items.title: Can’t reach after Active Sessions revoke — sign out/in, not Retry
items.summary: Staff (Colin): Apps showing Can’t-reach after an Active Sessions revoke on cursor.com still hold the old session—Retry/Update/Reset and VPN won’t help; sign out and back in on each device (0.39.0 is unrelated), and bots load once the new session sticks.

items.title: Linux RPM Access Denied — use direct package / yumrepo links
items.summary: Staff (deanrie, 2026-09-05): Download page RPM buttons still point at an old filename (Access Denied)—packages are fine; use the direct x64/arm64 0.39.0 RPM URLs or install via downloads.cursor.com yumrepo/grok-bot + anysphere.asc until the page is fixed.

items.title: Connected but “temporarily unreachable” — local-exec slower than 10s wait
items.summary: Staff (deanrie, 2026-09-05): On 0.43 Windows, ListMachines can show connected while Shell fails with temporarily unreachable when the PC answers ~11s but the agent stops waiting at 10s—commands did run; renaming the PC / toggling Local execution won’t help; share local-exec-daemon.log and check AV, OneDrive/AppData redirect, VPN/proxy.

items.title: Windows instant crash — Codex sandbox ACL missing S-1-15-2-2
items.summary: Staff (deanrie, 2026-09-05): Quiet Windows launch crash (int3 / 0x80000003) is often AppData\Local install ACLs left by CodexSandboxUsers without ALL RESTRICTED APPLICATION PACKAGES (S-1-15-2-2)—`--disable-gpu`/`--jitless` won’t help; diagnose with `--disable-gpu-sandbox`, then `icacls` grant S-1-15-2-1/2 (RX) on the Grok Bot folder (and optionally `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs`) or remove the orphaned

items.title: Windows: secret-card chat — replies missing in main pane (sidebar/mobile OK)
items.summary: Staff (deanrie, 2026-09-06): On 0.43 Windows, a chat where the bot asked for a key/password (secret card) can stop showing new replies in the main pane while sidebar preview and mobile stay current—messages still reach the bot; computer is fine so don’t Reset/Recover/reinstall/clear data; server-side fix rolls out automatically (≤24h), no app update needed; use mobile for that thread meantime.

items.title: Mac 0.43: secret-card chats — “Couldn’t load conversation” (iPhone/sidebar OK)
items.summary: Staff (deanrie, 2026-09-06): On 0.43.0 Mac desktop, a conversation where the bot asked for a secret/credential can stop opening (“Couldn’t load conversation”—misleading; not network); iPhone and sidebar preview still work and Mac sends still reach the bots—don’t Reset Agent Computer, reinstall, or update the app; background server fix applies per computer (few hours, ≤24h).

items.title: Mac 0.43: lost computer after password change — sign out/in, don’t Reset
items.summary: Staff (deanrie, 2026-09-06): On 0.43.0 Mac, a Cursor password change/reset (or sign-out elsewhere) can invalidate the desktop session so the app keeps the old token and shows “Couldn’t Reach Grok Bot’s Computer,” with Update/Recover/Reset also failing—computer and Bots are fine; sign out and back in on desktop (Quit from menu bar if Sign out is missing), don’t Reset.

items.title: Mac 0.43: main chat pane misses replies (sidebar + iOS OK) — don’t Reset
items.summary: Staff (deanrie, 2026-09-06): On Mac app 0.43.0 the main chat pane can stop live-updating so sends look undelivered and replies never appear there, while iPhone and the left sidebar preview stay current—bots still receive messages; don’t Reset/Restore/reinstall or recreate the Bot; use iOS (or unaffected bots) until the tracked UI bug is fixed.

items.title: Bots “not responding” / Reset failed — save Privacy Mode on dashboard
items.summary: Staff (deanrie, 2026-09-06): Account-wide unreachable bots with “Couldn’t refresh,” black bubbles, and “Reset failed” can mean no explicit Privacy Mode choice was saved (data notice alone is not enough)—computer/bots/files are safe; set Privacy Mode (not Legacy) at cursor.com/dashboard → Settings → Privacy, fully quit/reopen apps, wait ~1 minute; don’t keep hitting Reset/Retry/Recover.

items.title: Local Shell Auto-review: “executable content could not be bound” — pipe workaround
items.summary: Staff (deanrie, 2026-09-06): Local-exec Auto-review can reject before any approval card when Grok Bot can’t read a compiled binary (e.g. /usr/bin/python3) or flag-first args like python3 -c / bash -c—“Allow once” won’t help; pipe code in (echo "print('exec-ok')" | python3) or run a home-folder .py with just the interpreter name; avoid absolute program paths, -c, heredoc-on-stdin, and ~/ inside int

items.title: computerUse GTK Open Files no-ops — dock overlap; bypass with DOM.setFileInputFiles
items.summary: Staff (deanrie, 2026-09-06): On the Bot computer, GTK “Open Files” Open/Cancel often sit on the bottom dock so clicks hit the dock and the dialog no-ops (file itself is fine)—ask the Bot to set the page file input via DevTools DOM.setFileInputFiles to a /home/box/... path (no dialog), or drag/maximize the dialog so Open clears the dock; known dialog-geometry issue, tracked.

items.title: Can’t send (computer screen still visible) — server disconnect; prefer wait over Reset
items.summary: Staff (deanrie, 2026-09-07): When every send fails with “Couldn’t send / Failed to send” on all devices but the Agent Computer screen stays visible, it can be a temporary server-side loss of connection for some Grok Bot computers—not Mac/Android/app 0.44.0; connection usually returns without data loss, so message staff before Reset; Reset rebuilds from the last snapshot and may drop the newest uns

items.title: Gmail MCP: Spam search empty by default — use in:anywhere (+ label:SPAM)
items.summary: Staff (deanrie, 2026-09-07): Grok Bot’s Gmail connector search excludes Spam and Trash by default, so search_threads can return empty while list_labels still shows Spam counts—includeTrash only adds Trash, and in:spam / label:SPAM / is:spam do not override; ask the Bot for search_threads with in:anywhere label:SPAM (or in:anywhere is:unread); connector can move/label to Trash/Spam but Google’s ser

items.title: 0.44.0 Shell Auto-review pre-check: absolute interpreter path — use relative + cwd
items.summary: Staff (deanrie, 2026-09-07): On 0.44.0 the “executable content could not be bound” rejection is a pre-check before review, so no approval card (and no approval-request retry) appears—trips on absolute interpreter paths (/…/venv/bin/python), python3 -/ -c / -m, and heredocs into the interpreter; desktop updates won’t help (check isn’t in the app); until fixed, set working_directory and run a relati

items.title: CallDynamicTool Missing namespace/toolName — put keys top-level (or Duplicate)
items.summary: Staff (deanrie, 2026-09-07): When CallDynamicTool fails with “Missing required fields: namespace, toolName” while Shell/files still work, the bot nested namespace/toolName inside arguments—and bad shapes in chat history keep repeating. Reset Computer won’t help (history isn’t on the computer). Tell the bot: namespace and toolName must be top-level keys alongside arguments, never inside arguments,

items.title: Export/backup Bot memory — ask bots to zip durable state (no one-click yet)
items.summary: Staff (mohitjain, 2026-09-07): No one-click export yet—memory lives as plain text on the Bot computer. Per bot, ask it to make backup/<name>, copy full memory (profile + every memory-log month) to memory.md, list routines and connectors, zip and attach; ask Chief of Staff for shared-memory.md + skills-library zip; for other folders, zip/split (attachments cap 25 MB). Connector logins can’t be expo

items.title: iOS Inkbox “Unsupported redirect_uri” — auth on desktop (account-default shared)
items.summary: Staff (mohitjain, 2026-09-07): For account-default shared connectors like Inkbox, the identity you authorize on desktop carries to phone—you usually don’t need the iOS Connect card. If iOS still shows “Unsupported redirect_uri” but tools work after desktop auth, skip Connect on mobile and just ask the bot to use the tool (or reopen the app). Mobile connect-flow redirect_uri bugs remain tracked sep

items.title: Mac 0.43 one-agent Failed to send (iOS OK) — update desktop to 0.44.0
items.summary: Staff (mohitjain, 2026-09-07): If one Bot’s Mac chat shows “Failed to send” / missing replies while iPhone has the full thread and other Mac bots work, the bot is fine—desktop 0.43.0 can’t load that conversation; Reset/reinstall won’t help; update Grok Bot desktop to 0.44.0 (Settings → Updates; fully quit Cmd+Q if it claims you’re current) and use iOS until then.

items.title: Synced skills reach Agents Window only — not Grok Bot-started cloud agents
items.summary: Staff (deanrie, 2026-09-07): “Sync Skills for Cloud Agents” can hang on the final verification step after downloads finish (reason=missing), and even when sync succeeds only cloud agents started from the Cursor desktop Agents Window pick up ~/.cursor/skills—agents started from Grok Bot (or cursor.com/agents) do not yet; workaround: launch the cloud agent from Agents Window until the gap is fixed.

items.title: Public template publish “team must be selected” — leave leftover workspaces
items.summary: Staff (mohitjain, 2026-09-08): On personal Ultra, Public template export can fail with “A team must be selected to share a team template” when the account is still attached to leftover team workspaces (old invites/trials)—leave extra teams at cursor.com/dashboard, then ask the Bot to share as Public again for the review card and x.ai/bot link.

items.title: stdio MCP wrappers in bot secrets break after bot delete — use shared path
items.summary: Staff (mohitjain, 2026-09-08): Account-wide stdio MCP servers that spawn a wrapper under agents/<agentId>/secrets die when that bot is deleted—keep wrappers/creds in a bot-independent path (e.g. /home/box/mcp-wrappers/), re-point the server command (or register npx/uvx + env keys directly), then Restart MCP.

items.title: MCP “needsAuth” badge for non-OAuth connectors is cosmetic
items.summary: Staff (mohitjain, 2026-09-08): The Plugins badge only treats OAuth as authenticated, so public/API-token connectors (e.g. Cloudflare docs, Fastmail) can show needsAuth even when tools already run—Authenticate just reconfirms and a restart re-reads the same state; leave them as-is unless the badge blocks other bots.

items.title: GitHub plugin “Needs auth” / no sign-in link — PAT Setup Values already work
items.summary: Staff (mohitjain, 2026-09-08): The GitHub plugin signs in via the personal access token under Setup Values (Edit Values), not a browser OAuth link—so Needs auth plus “Github didn't provide a sign-in link” is a labeling bug when tools already load; confirm with “Using the GitHub connector, which GitHub user am I signed in as?” and ignore the badge.

items.title: Trial ended shows as “Can’t reach your computer” — renew/link plan
items.summary: Staff (deanrie, 2026-09-08): After the 1-week free Grok Bot trial ends, the app can keep showing “Can’t reach your computer” / *.cursorvm.com / Zscaler copy even though Retry/Recover/re-login won’t help—pick a plan that includes Grok Bot (or link SuperGrok at cursor.com with the same email), fully quit from the menu bar, reopen, and sign in again; bots/files stay saved.

items.title: Desktop reconnect overwrites in-chat secure secrets
items.summary: Staff (Colin, 2026-09-08): When the Grok Bot desktop app reconnects to your cloud computer (e.g. after sleep or an overnight drop), it re-syncs the app’s secrets list and currently overwrites secrets saved via the in-chat secure input—re-enter those credentials after reconnect until the sync bug is fixed; Update/Reset are not the cause.

items.title: Robinhood MCP OAuth: https callback + 15-minute window (connect on desktop)
items.summary: Staff (deanrie, 2026-09-09): Robinhood Agentic Trading MCP sign-in from Grok Bot no longer uses grokbot://—since 7 Sep it uses an https://www.cursor.com/agents/... callback—and the auth code expires in about 15 minutes, so finish Allow quickly (approve the Robinhood device first if asked); if phone OAuth keeps failing, connect once from Grok Bot desktop or Cursor on the same account so the trading

items.title: Home Wi-Fi: curl OK but streaming fails — Private Relay / cellular IP
items.summary: Staff (deanrie, 2026-09-09): When the cloud computer is healthy and hotspot works but home Wi-Fi fails—even if short curl to api2/cursorvm looks fine—the app needs long-lived streaming that your network may drop; fully Quit, then try iCloud Private Relay off, DNS back to router-automatic (remove 1.1.1.1/8.8.8.8), and check cellular routers that rotate multiple IPs (fine for curl, cuts long-lived a

items.title: Cursor password reset → ~30 min Authentication error (auto-reconnect)
items.summary: Staff (mohitjain, 2026-09-08): Resetting your Cursor password signs out every session—including the Bot cloud computer’s background session—so chat can return “Authentication error” for about 30 minutes; it reconnects on its own (no reinstall / Reset / Update). Sign the phone in with the new password; distinct from Mac “unavailable” expired-session UI (170389) and 0.43 sign-out tips (170775).

items.title: Routines need Cursor Pro+ — SuperGrok + Cursor Start won’t schedule
items.summary: Staff (Colin, 2026-09-09): Routines (scheduled runs) are the one Grok Bot feature that checks the Cursor plan—if Grok Bot access comes from a linked SuperGrok account while Cursor is on Start, the server refuses to schedule routines no matter how often you reset the bot or computer; move Cursor to Pro or higher and routines start syncing with no other changes (other Bot features keep working).

items.title: Windows F-Secure: DeepGuard delays local-exec past 10s (folder exclusions miss Temp)
items.summary: Staff (mohitjain, 2026-09-10): F-Secure often delays each local-exec command past the agent’s ~10s wait (not a hard block)—folder exclusions fail because each command is a fresh one-off PowerShell under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp. Bisect: DeepGuard off only → real-time off only → allow Grok Bot.exe from %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Grok Bot in DeepGuard → temporary Temp exclude as last test; report which step

items.title: Linux RPM links for GrokBot not working
items.summary: Staff (kevinn, 2026-09-10): download-page RPM links point at an old filename — use direct 0.47.0 x64/arm64 RPMs or the yumrepo + anysphere.asc dnf install path until the page is fixed.

items.title: macOS setup fails with unreachable — Bot name too long
items.summary: Staff (kevinn, 2026-09-10): “Can’t reach your computer” on first-Bot setup can be a >255-character Name field rejection misreported as connectivity — quit/reopen and create with a short name, then put long instructions in the first chat.

items.title: Can't reach computer — dual computer copies
items.summary: Staff (mohitjain, 2026-09-09): unreachable can mean the app points at a half-started computer copy while bots live on another — stop Reset/Update/Recover and wait for backend reconnect so the good copy stays intact.

items.title: Windows Kaspersky HTTPS scan → ConnectError.Internal / Can’t reach computer
items.summary: Staff (deanrie, 2026-09-11): Grok Bot trusts public CAs only—Kaspersky Encrypted connections scanning swaps the api2.cursor.sh issuer to Kaspersky Anti-Virus Personal Root Certificate and the app never reaches the Agent Computer (ConnectError.Internal). Turn scanning off or exception Grok Bot; do not Reset/Recover; confirm the cert issuer is Amazon RSA again, then quit/reopen and update past 0.44.

items.title: Server-stored webhook routines: desktop missing POST URL / crsr_ key
items.summary: Staff (deanrie, 2026-09-11): New Bots keep routines on the server, and the desktop app currently does not fetch webhook POST URL, crsr_ secret, or Authorization—recreate and deep links stay empty; bot cannot emit them. Known issue; temporary wake options are Slack channel message triggers or a schedule (not webhook credentials).

items.title: Windows in-app update Authenticode fail → install Setup.exe manually

items.title: Desktop reconnect re-sync wipes secure-card secrets
items.summary: Staff (deanrie): After sleep/drop/quit-reopen, desktop re-sync of the secrets list overwrites values saved via the secure in-chat card—Update/Reset/reinstall won’t help. Workaround: store keys in the Bot’s agent folder on the computer (less secure) until fixed.

items.title: Hung custom MCP remotes: delete via cursor.com/agents
items.summary: Staff (mohitjain): One hung custom HTTP MCP remote can stall discovery so Plugins→Yours never lists it and Uninstall times out. Self-serve fix: open cursor.com/agents → + → MCP Servers → Delete user config on that remote (works even while discovery hangs).

items.title: Unreachable from Bot OOM / parallel fan-out
items.summary: Staff (mohitjain): Recurring unreachable can be Agent Computer OOM when a Bot spins too many parallel processes—not your network. Prevention: worker concurrency 1 on production paths, no mass-resume after rematerialize, batch large fan-outs; avoid Reset while support restores.

items.title: Authentication error banner → Update Grok Bot’s Computer
items.summary: Staff (Colin): Persistent “Authentication error / try logging out” can be an outdated Agent Computer build after a backend change—accounts are fine; skip sign-out/reinstall. Fix: Settings → Updates → Update Grok Bot’s Computer, then reopen and send a message.

items.title: Higgsfield MCP drops until you reconnect before use
items.summary: Staff (mohitjain): Higgsfield’s sign-in can’t renew itself, so the connector drops after the first session expires—no Grok Bot setting holds it open. Workaround: reconnect Higgsfield right before you need it instead of leaving it connected all day.

items.title: No Chrome extension yet — iOS share sheet / paste URL workarounds
items.summary: Staff (deanrie): There is no separate Chrome extension for Grok Bot yet. On iOS, share a page/link/selection into Bot via the share sheet; from anywhere, paste a URL into chat so the Bot opens it on its cloud computer to summarize or act.

items.title: Ubuntu eCryptfs: sand-client ENAMETOOLONG blocks first setup
items.summary: Staff (Colin, 2026-09-13): Grok Bot stores ~140–200-char files under ~/.config/Grok Bot/sand-client-persistence/; Linux allows 255 but eCryptfs (“Encrypt my home folder”) caps names at 143 → ENAMETOOLONG on Ubuntu first setup. Check with getconf NAME_MAX ~/.config and mount | grep -i ecryptfs; team is shortening names.

items.title: Secure-card secrets miss running agent shells — spawn a fresh agent
items.summary: Staff (Colin, 2026-09-13): tokens saved via the secure card land in the Agent Computer’s main environment, but agents already open in their own window started a separate shell session that does not pick up later env changes—card shows Saved while the executor cannot see it. Workaround: after saving, create a brand-new agent (or rely on files on disk, which every agent can read); re-saving into an

items.title: Signature-Agent = Grok Bot computer Chrome, not Cloud Agents
items.summary: Staff (Colin, 2026-09-13): Signature-Agent / cursorusercontent.com traffic is the browser inside your Grok Bot Agent Computer—not Cloud Agents or the IDE browser. Health-check tabs stay open after the task and keep polling; stop by Open computer → close those Chrome tabs (or quit Chrome), pause/delete the Automations routine, or Reset Grok Bot’s Computer as last resort.

items.title: Private Slack channels need /invite @Cursor for routine triggers

Test Run bypasses Slack entirely; Slack plugin replies use a different app than the routine listener—so both can work while the trigger stays silent. Fix: in the private channel run /invite @Cursor, wait ~1 min, post a canary message, then check the routi

items.title: Take over shows main desktop — Bot may be on another display (Xvfb)
items.summary: Staff (deanrie, 2026-09-14): A “blank” Computer viewer can still be connected—Take over renders the Bot machine’s main desktop, while the Bot may have launched apps on a separate display (e.g. Xvfb :1); ask it to open something on the main desktop or align DISPLAY, don’t Reset.

items.title: Network Debugger when computer is healthy but app can’t connect (Windows)
items.summary: Staff (Colin, 2026-09-14): If Recover fails but the Agent Computer is healthy server-side, fully quit, reinstall from cursor.com/download/bot (keeps bots/files/logins), then open Settings → General → System → Network Debugger (or “Open Network Debugger” on the trouble-connecting screen); expand Details and check Api tls / Api unary / Computer tls / Updates feed, and name any AV (Kaspersky etc.)—OP

items.title: One bot silent / failed to send — reply runner stuck server-side; do NOT Reset
items.summary: Staff (deanrie, 2026-09-16): when one Bot fails to send while others and the Agent Computer stay fine, reply processing for that Bot is stuck on Cursor’s side—not your setup; skip Update/Recover/Reset; files and history stay; report last message time + Bot ID if it happens again after a tool call.

items.title: GitHub “issue assigned” routine never fires on github.com
items.summary: Staff (deanrie, 2026-09-16): with correct repo access and filters, the GitHub issue-assigned trigger still does not fire for github.com repos (known server-side); filter matches the assigner; no user-facing event log yet; temporary workaround is a scheduled routine (webhook may also be blocked by the 171324 panel bug until 0.53.0).

items.title: Onboarding provisioning fails — create first Bot on mobile, then Update Computer
items.summary: Staff (deanrie, 2026-09-16): first-Bot provisioning can fail when the account’s cloud computer is stuck server-side—reinstall/retry won’t fix it; workaround is create the first Bot in the phone app, then on desktop Settings → Updates → Update Grok Bot’s Computer; staff can also recreate the computer.

items.title: update_state memory writes fail fleet-wide — write memory files directly; don’t Reset
items.summary: Staff (deanrie, 2026-09-16): update_state target:memory fails fleet-wide with “brain docs snapshot was cut short before completing” while settings updates and direct file edits still work—known server-side; workaround is write facts into memory/profile.md or memory/log/YYYY-MM.md; Update/Reset Computer won’t help.

items.title: Custom MCP OAuth DCR: cursor:// callback breaks Cloudflare https-only allowlists
items.summary: Staff (deanrie, 2026-09-16): Dynamic Client Registration sends three redirect_uris—cursor://anysphere.cursor-mcp/oauth/callback, https://www.cursor.com/agents/mcp/oauth/callback, and http://localhost:8787/callback; Grok Bot desktop uses localhost, but Cloudflare Managed OAuth rejects the whole set because it can’t allowlist cursor://—tracked server-side fix to drop non-https callbacks.

items.title: Windows Ctrl+, Settings shortcut blocks Traditional Chinese full-width comma
items.summary: Staff (Colin, 2026-09-16): on Windows, Bopomofo/Zhuyin Ctrl+, for full-width 「，」 still triggers Grok Bot’s Settings shortcut—flagged to the team; interim workaround is Shift+Space to full-width (全形) mode then press , alone (no Ctrl), then Shift+Space back to half-width.

items.title: Routine Edit opens chat by design; webhook panel needs desktop 0.53.0

items.title: UI rename fails — ask the Bot to rename itself (staff)
items.summary: Staff (mohitjain): Grok Bot UI rename often doesn’t stick (tracked bug). Best workaround for now: ask the Bot/agent to rename itself — that sticks. Not a local setup issue.

items.title: Parent Bot goes quiet after Cloud Agent handoff (staff)
items.summary: Staff (Colin, 2026-09-17): When a Grok Bot hands work to a Cursor Cloud Agent the parent chat goes quiet until that agent finishes (auto-wakes then)—expected today, not a hang. Watch live status at cursor.com/agents or Cursor desktop, or ask the parent to attach the agent card for Running/Done inline; in-flight visibility in the parent chat is being improved.

items.title: iOS Settings scroll can flip Auto-review — scroll on the label (staff)
items.summary: Staff (kevinn, 2026-09-17): On Grok Bot iOS Settings, a scroll that starts on a switch can flip it (reproduced; tracking). The protective control is Auto-review (not labeled “Agent guards”). Workaround until fixed: start the scroll on the row text, not on the switch itself.

items.title: 172033 Sidebar sections: desktop New Section + no agent create tool
items.summary: Staff (kevinn): agents can list sections and CreateAgent can place into one, but there is no tool to create/rename/delete/move sections — on desktop right-click Move to → New Section (mobile long-press).

items.title: iOS 1.11.1+ Voice icon is a gradual account rollout (staff)
items.summary: Staff (kevinn, 2026-09-18): Missing voice/call icon on Grok Bot iOS 1.11.1 is not a device bug—Voice chat is rolling out gradually to accounts on 1.11.1+; reinstall/sign-out will not speed it up. Desktop Voice stays available; phone composer dictation mic still works until the button appears.

items.title: No delete/redact of sent messages — use secure input for secrets (staff)
items.summary: Staff (kevinn, 2026-09-17): Grok Bot cannot delete or redact a sent message (only failed-to-send messages have Delete)—rotate any pasted secret on the provider. Prefer asking the bot to request the credential: it shows a masked secure input card, stores the value as a bot secret, and keeps it out of the transcript and model context.

items.title: Forum: Bots failed to respond and Reset failed on 8 Oct 2026
items.summary: Thread where several users on 0.68.1 saw "Bot failed to respond" and then "Reset failed … may be in a partial state" on 8 Oct 2026; staff confirmed a server-side issue that stopped Bots replying was fixed the same day, that the reset error came from a separate brief server problem that has also cleared, and that no reset is needed.

items.title: Forum: "can't reach your computer" after the trial ended
items.summary: Report of Grok Bot on macOS saying it cannot reach the computer while Recover and Reset both fail; staff explained the account's one-week trial had ended, so requests were rejected before they started and nothing on the computer changed, called the connection error screen misleading and tracked, and pointed to choosing a plan or linking SuperGrok.

items.title: Forum: Grok Bot's own host process filling the computer's memory
items.summary: Report that the app's host process on a Bot Computer held about 15 GB of 16 GB RAM from 7 Oct, so commands were killed or hung and Update said it was current; staff confirmed it, said Reset is the way out because it restores the last snapshot saved minutes before, and passed the leak to the team as it recurred on a fresh computer.

items.title: Forum: request to let Grok Bot use your local computer's screen
items.summary: Feature request for Grok Bot to see, click and type on the user's own Mac; staff replied that screen work currently happens only on the Bot's cloud computer, that on a connected Mac it can run commands and move files with approval, and asked which apps and signed-in sites people would want it to drive.

items.title: Forum: request to export full chat transcripts
items.summary: Feature request for word-for-word chat export as Markdown or JSON, both from an app button for one chat or a date range and by the Bot itself to a file on its computer so backups can run as a routine, since having a Bot read and copy its history today uses many tokens.

items.title: Forum: scheduled routines failed for everyone on 8 Oct 2026
items.summary: Thread with many users reporting that every scheduled routine was delayed or marked Failed from midday UK time on 8 Oct 2026; staff said it was very high load on Grok Bot's side, that routines were held back again after about 21:00 UK time, and that direct messages still worked.

items.title: Forum: one Bot stuck on "failed to respond" because of its chat history
items.summary: Report of a primary Bot that stopped replying while other Bots on the same computer worked; staff found the model provider's safety filter was flagging security-related content in that Bot's conversation history, so every reply sent with that history was refused.

items.title: Forum: Bots sending a bare "." in 1:1 and team chats
items.summary: Bug report (9 Oct 2026) that Bots post a single "." alongside normal replies; staff confirmed Bots were sending it when they should stay quiet, which sets off other Bots in group chats, and flagged it to the team.

items.title: Forum: remote MCP header missing on reused sessions (HTTP 400)
items.summary: Developer report with a runnable reproduction that Grok Bot drops the MCP-Protocol-Version header when it reuses a remote MCP session, so strict servers return an empty HTTP 400; staff confirmed it and flagged the suggested fix.

items.title: Forum: UpdateRoutine rejects email trigger on claimed inbox
items.summary: Report that ClaimEmailInbox succeeds for a @mail.grokbot.com address but UpdateRoutine with an email trigger on that inbox fails validation with “Not a valid trigger,” blocking email-triggered routines on the new Bot mail feature.

items.title: Forum: macOS local computer stays disconnected until app focused
items.summary: Bug on Grok Bot 0.68.1 (macOS) where the Mac computer link shows disconnected for long stretches while the machine is awake and in use; Shell from Bots fails until the Grok Bot app is focused, and staff called it a known resource-saving issue under investigation.

items.title: Forum: Enterprise — can admins block members creating bots?

items.title: Forum: bots error out on scientific literature review
